newsitem.title: USA: United Auto Group opens used car lots.
newsitem.headline: United Auto Group opens used car lots.

text.p: United Auto Group Inc said Wednesday it has opened two stand-alone United AutoMart used vehicle facilities in Arkansas, its seventh and eighth nationally.
The new facilities, located in Benton and Hot Springs, will be known as Landers United AutoMart, and are operated by the company's Benton-based Landers Auto Sales, acquired in 1995.
Landers United AutoMart has other locations in North and West Little Rock. United Auto also operates United AutoMart facilities in Danbury, Conn., and Atlanta.
